gallery.title: File:Sandbach Town Charter.jpg
gallery.description: Reproduction of Queen Elizabeth I's 1579 Royal Charter, awarded to Sir John Radcliffe of Ordsall for a market to be held in Sandbach.

gallery.title: File:Sandbach Roll of Honour (1914-1919).jpg
gallery.description:
Sandbach Roll of Honour European War (1914-1919) The text reads:
ROLL OF HONOUR
EUROPEAN WAR 1914 - 19.
SANDBACH LITERARY INSTITUTE
S BOLSHAW   S JACKSON F LUNT   J MERCER   W UPTON
The above Five Members made the supreme sacrifice.
Miss M BOULTON, 
H ALLMAN, 
G W BOULTON, 
P BUMBY, 
M COOPER, 
W FITHON, 
F LATHAM, 
S LUNT, 
T F REDWOOD, 
R SLADE, 
H SMITH, 
H BOULTON, 
C D BRADDON, 
E BUTLER, 
F J FINLOW, 
A JONES, 
T LATHAM, 
H PRICE, 
J W R SKERRATT, 
D SLAVE, 
J S STRINGER, 

G W COOKE
